title: Configurable splash screen wallpaper apart from changing the entire splash screen theme
line: The Splash Screen settings page now has a Background image field, and the Breeze splash screen shows the chosen image.
explanation: Splash themes draw their whole screen themselves, and there was no setting for the background, so the only way to get the default splash screen with another picture was to install a near-identical theme from the store (Nate notes that's what almost all store themes are). ksplashqml now reads a Background entry from ksplashrc (or a --background option used for previews) and sets it on the theme's root item as backgroundImage; the Breeze splash screen declares that property and shows the image, cropped to fill, behind its logo. The Splash Screen KCM gets a Background image field with a file picker, Defaults/Apply support, and passes the pending image to Preview.

commits.message:
ksplash: show a user-chosen background image on the splash screen

Using the default splash screen with another background meant installing
a whole new theme. ksplashqml now reads a Background image from the
ksplashrc file or --background, and the Breeze splash screen shows it.

BUG: 355250

kcms/ksplash: add a setting for the splash screen background image

The page only let you pick a whole splash theme, so changing just the
background needed a new theme from the store. Add a Background image
field with a file picker, saved to ksplashrc and used by Preview too.

BUG: 355250

patches.diff:
From dd394b664b7c1344478e1d4924beb2fddb08e031 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:18:22 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] kcms/ksplash: add a setting for the splash screen background
 image

The page only let you pick a whole splash theme, so changing just the
background needed a new theme from the store. Add a Background image
field with a file picker, saved to ksplashrc and used by Preview too.

BUG: 355250
---
 kcms/ksplash/kcm.cpp                   |  6 +++-
 kcms/ksplash/splashscreensettings.kcfg |  3 ++
 kcms/ksplash/ui/main.qml               | 45 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 53 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/kcms/ksplash/kcm.cpp b/kcms/ksplash/kcm.cpp
index e9dacab4fc..c42eeeef4a 100644
--- a/kcms/ksplash/kcm.cpp
+++ b/kcms/ksplash/kcm.cpp
@@ -241,7 +241,11 @@ void KCMSplashScreen::test(const QString &plugin)
     });
 
     Q_EMIT testingChanged();
-    m_testProcess->start(QStringLiteral("ksplashqml"), {plugin, QStringLiteral("--test")});
+    QStringList arguments{plugin, QStringLiteral("--test")};
+    if (!m_data->settings()->background().isEmpty()) {
+        arguments << QStringLiteral("--background") << m_data->settings()->background();
+    }
+    m_testProcess->start(QStringLiteral("ksplashqml"), arguments);
 }
 
 QStringList KCMSplashScreen::pendingDeletions()
diff --git a/kcms/ksplash/splashscreensettings.kcfg b/kcms/ksplash/splashscreensettings.kcfg
index 87e2684b66..7c2b5199b5 100644
--- a/kcms/ksplash/splashscreensettings.kcfg
+++ b/kcms/ksplash/splashscreensettings.kcfg
@@ -16,5 +16,8 @@
       <label>Name of the current splash theme</label>
       <default>org.kde.breeze.desktop</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="background" key="Background" type="String">
+      <label>Image shown instead of the splash theme's own background, for themes that support it</label>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/kcms/ksplash/ui/main.qml b/kcms/ksplash/ui/main.qml
index 6e1f59c83d..0eee854b45 100644
--- a/kcms/ksplash/ui/main.qml
+++ b/kcms/ksplash/ui/main.qml
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Window
 import QtQuick.Layouts
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Dialogs as QtDialogs
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.newstuff as NewStuff
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
@@ -60,6 +62,49 @@ KCM.GridViewKCM {
         }
     }
 
+    footer: RowLayout {
+        spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+        QQC2.Label {
+            text: i18nc("@label:textbox", "Background image:")
+        }
+
+        QQC2.TextField {
+            id: backgroundField
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            text: kcm.splashScreenSettings.background
+            placeholderText: i18nc("@info:placeholder", "Use the splash screen's own background")
+
+            KCM.SettingStateBinding {
+                configObject: kcm.splashScreenSettings
+                settingName: "background"
+                extraEnabledConditions: kcm.splashScreenSettings.theme !== "None"
+            }
+
+            onTextEdited: kcm.splashScreenSettings.background = text
+        }
+
+        QQC2.Button {
+            icon.name: "folder"
+            enabled: backgroundField.enabled
+            QQC2.ToolTip.visible: hovered
+            QQC2.ToolTip.text: i18nc("@action:button icononly tooltip", "Choose background image")
+            Accessible.name: i18nc("@action:button accessible only", "Choose background image")
+            onClicked: backgroundDialog.open()
+        }
+
+        Kirigami.ContextualHelpButton {
+            toolTipText: i18nc("@info:tooltip", "Splash screens that support it, such as Breeze, show this image instead of their own background.")
+        }
+
+        QtDialogs.FileDialog {
+            id: backgroundDialog
+            title: i18nc("@title:window", "Choose Background Image")
+            nameFilters: [i18nc("Name filter in a file dialog", "Image files (*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.webp *.avif *.jxl *.svg *.svgz)")]
+            onAccepted: kcm.splashScreenSettings.background = selectedFile
+        }
+    }
+
     view.delegate: KCM.GridDelegate {
         id: delegate
 
--
